verdict.rationale: Orb is a usage-based billing SaaS, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions source availability, a public repository, or any open-source license. The SDK listing only names supported languages and says nothing about licensing, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
